lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-intensity pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The pattern transitions from a dense, irregular clustering near the head to a more structured grid-like arrangement on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the primary blobs, forming a discernible grid-like anchor system across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a high-intensity upper boundary and a low-intensity shadow immediately below, extending toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains sparse, low-contrast high-luminance blobs distributed across its surface, with higher density observed near the fin base.
